panel.name: KAMI RLV Safety
panel.label: RLV Safety
panel.text: 神 KAMI RLV SAFETY | 安全
RLVa engine unavailable. All RLV commands are disabled.
KAMI has no functional RLVa command processor in this build. The old unsupported switches are intentionally unavailable. No scripted object or relay can enable RLV by toggling a legacy setting.

Future RLVa must require your consent per object and action, refuse unknown commands, deny relay and sensitive commands by default, expire grants, and always permit your emergency exit. RLV must never lock you out of viewer controls.

button.name: kami_rlv_emergency_release
button.label: EMERGENCY RELEASE - BLOCK RLV
button.tool_tip: Always available to the wearer. Clears future policy permissions and disables the legacy RLV switch. There is no RLV engine in this build.

panel.text: Safety lock ON. No RLVa engine installed. An emergency release disables the legacy RLV flag.
